title: Smart Fan selects PECI Agent1 for SYSFAN
description: The routine selects PECI Agent1 for SYSFAN; its validity on the one-socket board is unverified. The hidden SYSFAN mode defaults to Full On and all seven saved records have Full On, which limits present relevance.
remediation: Validate agent presence, the source/header relationship and the automatic mode before a one-byte Agent0 substitution. No candidate, C2.
